picks.headline: Ocean Swift intros DevOcean Modular with MaYa, an AI agent that patches alongside you
picks.rationale: Highest actionability in the fresh pool: a shipping 145-module synthesis environment whose AI agent collaboratively builds and patches modular setups with the producer instead of one-shot generating — a concrete change to how sound designers work tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: Ocean Swift's DevOcean Modular is a 145-module software synthesis and sound-design environment whose standout is MaYa, a modular AI agent that builds and patches modular setups collaboratively alongside the user rather than just auto-generating a result.

picks.headline: Why a fight over 61,000 recordings could shape the future of AI music licensing
picks.rationale: A distinct court development (not the earlier Suno data-leak card) whose fair-use precedent will govern how AI music tools can legally be trained and licensed — the most consequential industry story in the fresh pool.
picks.excerpt: Suno challenged UMG and Sony's bid to add over 61,000 recordings to their copyright suit; the fair-use fight could set the precedent shaping how AI music tools can legally be trained and licensed.

picks.headline: Josh Fawaz Adds AI Credits to 'Like a Prayer' on Spotify After Widespread Backlash
picks.rationale: A concrete, high-profile disclosure case (38M streams) showing the emerging norm of crediting AI vocals/drums — the real-world practice behind the labeling debates, and directly relevant to how creators tag AI work.
picks.excerpt: After an ABC investigation revealed heavy generative-AI use, Australian DJ Josh Fawaz added AI-vocal and AI-drum credits to his 38M-stream Madonna cover 'Like a Prayer,' spotlighting disclosure norms for AI-made hits.
